# <!--name-->Changelog comment<!--/name-->
<!--description-->
Downloads the changelog-decision artifact from the triggering workflow run and posts or updates the sticky changelog PR comment. Safe to call even when no artifact was uploaded — the command succeeds with no action taken.
<!--/description-->
